scope: Windows x64 JIT repository and real package consumers. Browser selected-notification recovery has a separate receipt at the same source commit. Fixed DSH interop and Native AOT caller results remain bound in the earlier local evidence receipt; they are not reruns of this final candidate. No Linux, hosted CI, remote SourceLink retrieval, source-archive build or Maker execution is claimed.

contract.unary: Generated Task<RemoteResult<T>> uses correlated fixed envelopes; no-value and null remain distinct. Local preparation failures stay outside RemoteResult.
contract.stream: Eager logical open after preparation; raw items, typed input, local Send, ordered half-close, and awaited local retirement. No remote release acknowledgement.
contract.uplinkFacts: RemoteUplink IAsyncEnumerable<T> retains root and nested nullability in the common model. RemoteOptional<T> expresses absence without a new wire wrapper.
contract.ownership: Host Connection owns its operator Peer; sockets and logical calls borrow it. Generated client retirement drains its work without owning shared Connection or caller Context.
contract.models: Independent clients compose explicit source reference models; no provider implementation or metadata-only reconstruction of missing defaults.
contract.removed: Simplified envelope, per-method NDJSON, base64 unary attachment substitute and generated transport state machines.
contract.remaining: Reverse Context and owned-value event handling, fixed complete event workflow, browser scoped facade, broader model backends and the remaining original platform obligations.
